title: Montana BEAD result hold: detailed terrestrial and LEO schemas still lack completed public awardee tables
summary: ConnectMT publishes forms, instructions, served-location files, test controls, and monitoring guidance, but the public resource index does not expose completed awardee quarterly or closeout outcome tables. Denominator: Each stable terrestrial or LEO award and approved location cohort by quarter, with served, subscribed, tested, retained, failed, remediated, and accepted counts.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Observed adoption outcome hold.
